title: 5xx spike after payment gateway client upgrade
rootCause: New gateway client v2 silently changed the timeout default from 30s to 5s, causing confirmation calls to fail under normal load.
resolution: Rolled back gateway client, added explicit timeout config, added contract test for client defaults.

title: Token endpoint latency regression after rate limiter deploy
rootCause: Rate limiting middleware performed a synchronous Redis call on every request without connection pooling, adding ~1.5s under load.
resolution: Switched to pooled Redis client and made limiter checks async with a local cache fallback.

title: SQS queue backup during batch write rollout
rootCause: Batched writes introduced a lock contention issue on the inventory table, slowing consumer throughput below producer rate.
resolution: Reduced batch size, added consumer autoscaling based on queue depth.

title: Checkout errors during flash sale traffic spike
rootCause: Autoscaling policy did not account for burst traffic patterns, leading to connection pool exhaustion.
resolution: Pre-scaled ahead of known sale events, added circuit breaker on downstream payment calls.
